introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead. Then raise both your arms and legs up off the floor. \n\nHold this position for two seconds. Return to the start position and repeat.
name: SUPERMAN

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too hard, alternately raise your opposite legs and arms.
To make it easier, you can just raise your legs or arms.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, curve your back upward and let your head come down. Repeat the exercise.

Do it slowly with each step of this exercise.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand on the floor with feet shoulder width apart, then rotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.\n\nRelax your shoulders. Your toes should always face forward.
name: TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
Please don\'t twist your legs.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended and your thumbs pointing up, your body should be in the shape of the letter “Y”.\n\nRaise your arms off the ground as far as you can and pause them at the top for 2 seconds. Slowly go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.
name: FLOOR Y RAISES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Tighten your abdominals.
Pause your arms at the top, then slowly drop them down.
Exhale when lifting your arms, and inhale when dropping them down.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back.

introduce:
Kneel down and sit back on your heels. Support your hands on the floor in front of you. 

Push your pelvis forward, and keep your lumbar region still. 

Inhale, and round your upper back. Exhale, and pull your chest out. Repeat the exercise.
name: THORACIC SPINE CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lumbar region still during exercise.
Inhale as you round your upper back, and exhale as you pull your chest out.
This exercise can mobilize your upper back.

introduce:
Start on your knees and elbows. Place your elbows under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. 

Drop your head on the floor, and put your hands on the top of your head. Round your spine while keeping your upper back still. 

Inhale, and drop your pelvis down. Exhale, and round your spine. Repeat the exercise.
name: LUMBAR CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper back still during exercise.
Inhale as you drop your pelvis down, and exhale as you round your spine.
This exercise can mobilize your lumbar spine.
